user.title: BTicino HOMETOUCH
user.description: Sign in with a **dedicated** Door Entry account, invited to the system by its owner (not your personal account). Home Assistant becomes one more phone of the system; the password is not stored.

reuse.title: Existing connection
reuse.description: A previous connection to the system was found in the configuration folder. Use it again (no new phone is created).

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The token is no longer valid; enter the current one.

error.no_plants: No system visible: accept the invitation in the Door Entry app first
error.invalid_auth: Invalid token or client not allowed

init.title: Entrances
init.description: One opening button per entrance: name and lock address, separated by commas. Example: `Scala=20, Esterno=21` (the entrance panel's lock is usually 20, a second one 21).
